name: Escitalopram
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: MAO inhibitors (including linezolid and IV methylene blue), within 14 days

key_interactions.effect: Higher pimozide levels; QT prolongation and arrhythmias (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Other serotonergic drugs (SSRIs, SNRIs, triptans, tricyclics, opioids, lithium, buspirone, St John's wort)
key_interactions.action: Monitor at start and dose increases; stop if serotonin syndrome occurs.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: NSAIDs, aspirin, warfarin and other antiplatelets or anticoagulants
key_interactions.action: Warn the patient; monitor INR closely with warfarin.
